entries.source: organizing my inventory, I came across some #YELLOW#Smelly Toxin#LAST# that a colleague claimed could actually turn creatures to stone.  Truly exotic!
entries.target: 整理货物时，我偶然发现了一些#YELLOW#恶臭毒素#LAST#，一位同行声称它竟然能将生物石化。真是奇特！

entries.source: What?!? Just because you rescued me from a moderately-to-extremely gruesome death, you think that entitles you to take liberties?!
entries.target: 什么？！就因为你把我从相当乃至极其凄惨的死亡中救了出来，你就觉得有权对我放肆了？！

entries.source: WHY AREN'T WOMEN ATTRACTED TO ME I'M A NICE %s.
entries.target: 为什么女人就是不喜欢我呢？我明明是个大好%s啊。

entries.source: GIRL
entries.target: 女孩

entries.source: GUY
entries.target: 男人

entries.source: Uhh, sorry I hear my father calling, see you.
entries.target: 呃，不好意思，我听到我父亲在叫我了，再见。

entries.source: Just a minute, I was just...
entries.target: 等等，我刚才只是……

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She looks at you cheerfully.*#WHITE#
Just kidding. I would love that!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她欢快地看着你。*#WHITE#
开个玩笑啦。我很乐意！

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[walk away with her]#WHITE#What about a little trip to the south, from the coastline we can see the Charred Scar Volcano, it is a wonderous sight.
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[和她一起漫步]#WHITE#去南边短途旅行如何？我们可以从海岸线上看到灼烧之痕火山，那是一处壮丽的奇景。

entries.source: Joke's on you really, goodbye!
entries.target: 其实是你被耍了，再见！

entries.source: But... ok goodbye.
entries.target: 但是……好吧，再见。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You take Melinda in your arms and press her against you. The warmth of the contact lightens your heart.*#WHITE#
I feel safe in your arms. Please, I know you must leave, but promise to come back soon and hold me again.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你将梅琳达搂入怀中，紧紧抱住她。相拥的温暖让你的心情为之一畅。*#WHITE#
在你的怀抱里我觉得好安心。求求你，我知道你必须离开，但答应我快点回来再次抱抱我。

entries.source: I think I would enjoy that very much. #LIGHT_GREEN#[kiss her]#WHITE#
entries.target: 我想我也会非常乐意的。#LIGHT_GREEN#[亲吻她]#WHITE#

entries.source: That thought will carry me in the dark places I shall walk. #LIGHT_GREEN#[kiss her]#WHITE#
entries.target: 这份思念将陪伴我走过即将踏足的黑暗之地。#LIGHT_GREEN#[亲吻她]#WHITE#

entries.source: Oh, I am sorry. I think you are mistaken. I was only trying to comfort you.
entries.target: 噢，抱歉，我想你误会了。我只是想安慰你。

entries.source: Oh, sorry, I was not myself. Goodbye, then. Farewell.
entries.target: 噢，对不起，我刚才失态了。那么，再见吧。保重。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Melinda looks worried*#WHITE#
Please tell me you can help!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*梅琳达面露忧色*#WHITE#
请告诉我你能帮帮我！

entries.source: Yes, I think so. Some time ago I assumed ownership of a very special home... #LIGHT_GREEN#[tell her the Fortress story]#WHITE#
entries.target: 是的，我想能行。前些日子我接管了一处非常特别的家园……#LIGHT_GREEN#[向她讲述关于堡垒的故事]#WHITE#

entries.source:
An ancient fortress of a mythical race?! How #{bold}#exciting#{normal}#!
And you say it could cure me?
entries.target:
神话种族的古代堡垒？！太#{bold}#令人兴奋#{normal}#了！
你是说它能治好我？

entries.source: The Fortress seems to think so. I know this might sound a bit .. inappropriate .. but you would need to come live there, at least for a while.
entries.target: 堡垒似乎是这么认为的。我知道这听起来可能有点……不太合适……但你得搬去那里住，至少要住一阵子。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She looks at you cheerfully*#WHITE#
Ah the plan to sleep with me is finally revealed!
Shhh you dummy, I thought we were past such silliness, I will come, both for my health and because I want to be with you.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She kisses you tenderly*#WHITE#
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她欢快地看着你*#WHITE#
啊哈，想跟我睡在一起的计划终于暴露了吧！
嘘，你这个大傻瓜，我还以为我们早就不用再为这种事扭扭捏捏了。我会去的，既是为了我的健康，也是因为我想和你在一起。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她温柔地亲吻了你*#WHITE#

entries.source: Then my lady, if you will follow me. #LIGHT_GREEN#[take her to the Fortress]
entries.target: 那么，小姐，请随我来。#LIGHT_GREEN#[带她前往堡垒]

entries.source: Welcome @playername@ to my shop.
entries.target: @playername@，欢迎来到我的商店。

entries.source: Let me see your wares.
entries.target: 让我看看你的商品吧。

entries.source: I am looking for martial training.
entries.target: 我在寻求战斗训练。

entries.source: Sorry, I have to go!
entries.target: 抱歉，我要走了！

entries.source: I can indeed offer some martial training (talent category Technique/Combat-training) for a fee of 50 gold pieces; or the basic usage of bows and slings (Shoot talent) for 8 gold pieces.
entries.target: 我的确可以为你提供战斗训练（技巧/战斗训练系），你需要花费50金币，或者可以学习使用弓和投石索（射击天赋），花费8金币。

entries.source: Please train me in generic weapons and armour usage.
entries.target: 请教我通用武器和护甲的使用方法。

entries.source: The smith spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of armour and weapon usage.
entries.target: 铁匠花了一些时间，教你武器和护甲的基础使用方法。

entries.source: Please train me in the basic usage of bows and slings.
entries.target: 请教我弓和投石索的基础使用方法。

entries.source: The smith spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of bows and slings.
entries.target: 铁匠花了一些时间，教你弓和投石索的基础使用方法。

entries.source: No thanks.
entries.target: 不用了，谢谢。

entries.source: I do not have time to talk. This ritual is intense, and we are not alone here. Stop them!
entries.target: 我没时间和你说话。仪式非常紧迫，而且这里还有别人，阻止他们！

entries.source: I will not let you down!
entries.target: 我不会让你失望的！

entries.source: [leave]
entries.target: [离开]

entries.source:
Please save me! I will make it worth your whi..
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The assassin lord hits him in the face.#WHITE#*Shut up!
entries.target:
救救我！我会好好报答你的……
*#LIGHT_GREEN#刺客领主猛抽了一下他的脸。#WHITE#*闭嘴！

entries.source: Sorry, I have to go!
entries.target: 抱歉，我要走了！

entries.source: Please get me out of here!
entries.target: 请带我离开这儿！

entries.source: Come, there is a way out!
entries.target: 跟我来，这里有条路可以出去！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Ben lies defeated at your feet*#WHITE#
T...thank you for... *cough*... saving me from the curse.
I did no... not want for this to...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*he coughs one last time and dies, a smile on his face as his curse is gone.*#WHITE#
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*本恩倒在你的脚下。*#WHITE#
谢……谢谢你……*咳嗽*……救我摆脱了诅咒。
我不……不想让事情变成……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他最后咳嗽一声，含笑死去，诅咒终于消散。*#WHITE#

entries.source: Rest in peace.
entries.target: 安息吧。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a man covered in dirt and blood. He is out of breath and half mad.*#WHITE#
PLEASE! You must help! #{bold}#IT#{normal}# is slaughtering everybody in my village! Please!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He points his finger at the nearby forest.*#WHITE#
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个满身是血和污泥的男人。他上气不接下气，失魂落魄。*#WHITE#
救命！求你救救我们！#{bold}#它#{normal}#正在屠杀我们村里的所有人！求求你！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他伸手指着附近的树林。*#WHITE#

entries.source: I will go there and see what I can do.
entries.target: 我去看看我能做什么。

entries.source: This is not my problem. Go away!
entries.target: 和我没关系，闪开！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a young man, a novice mage by his looks*#WHITE#
Good day to yo...#LIGHT_GREEN#*He stares at you and starts to run away fast!*#WHITE#
Do not kill me please!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个年轻人，看上去像是一个法师学徒。*#WHITE#
你好……#LIGHT_GREEN#*他盯着你，随即撒腿就跑！*#WHITE#
请不要杀我！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a young man, a novice mage by his looks*#WHITE#
Good day to you, fellow traveler!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个年轻人，看上去像是一个法师学徒。*#WHITE#
你好啊，旅行者！

entries.source: What brings an apprentice mage out into the wilds?
entries.target: 你一个法师学徒，怎么会跑到荒野里来？

entries.source: I found this artefact; it looks powerful and arcane infused. Maybe it would be enough?
entries.target: 我发现了这件充满奥术能量的神器，看上去很强大，应该够了吧？

entries.source: So you have enough magical items now?
entries.target: 这么说，你现在已经有足够的魔法物品了？

entries.source: Sorry I have to go!
entries.target: 抱歉，我必须得走了！

entries.source: Ahh, my story is a sad one... I should not trouble you with it, my friend.
entries.target: 啊，我的故事说来让人伤心……算了，我不应该打扰你的，我的朋友。

entries.source: It is no trouble at all! Please tell me!
entries.target: 没关系的，告诉我吧！

entries.source: Ok, bye then!
entries.target: 好的，那么再见！

entries.source:
Well, if you insist...
I am a novice mage, as you might have noticed, and my goal is to be accepted by the people of Angolwen and be taught the secrets of the arcane.
entries.target:
好吧，假如你坚持的话……
我是个法师学徒，你可能已经看出来了。我的目标是得到安格利文人的接纳，向他们学习奥术的秘密。

entries.source: Who are the people of Angolwen?
entries.target: 安格利文人是什么人？

entries.source: Ah yes, Angolwen, I have called it home for many years...
entries.target: 啊，安格利文，我多年来一直把那里当作家……

entries.source: Well, good luck, bye!
entries.target: 那么，祝你好运，再见！

entries.source:
The keepers of ar... err, I do not think I am supposed to talk about them... sorry, my friend...
In any case, I must collect many items. I have some already but I am still looking for an arcane-infused artefact. You do not happen to have one, I imagine... Well, if you do, tell me please!
entries.target:
他们守护着奥……呃，我好像不该谈论他们……抱歉，我的朋友……
无论如何，我必须收集许多物品。我已经有了一些，但还在寻找一件充满奥术能量的神器。我想你不会碰巧有一件吧……嗯，要是你有，请一定告诉我！

entries.source: I will keep that in mind!
entries.target: 好的，我记住了！

entries.source: No way, bye!
entries.target: 算了吧，再见！

entries.source:
I hope I will too...
In any case, I must collect many items. I have some already but I am still looking for an arcane-infused artefact. You do not happen to have one, I imagine... Well, if you do, tell me please!
entries.target:
我也希望有朝一日能把那里当作家……
无论如何，我必须收集许多物品。我已经有了一些，但还在寻找一件充满奥术能量的神器。我想你不会碰巧有一件吧……嗯，要是你有，请一定告诉我！

entries.source:
Let me examine it.
Oh yes, my friend, this is indeed a powerful artefact! I think that it should suffice to complete my quest! Many thanks!
entries.target:
让我仔细看看。
哦，没错，我的朋友，这确实是一件强大的神器！我想有了它就足以完成我的任务了！万分感谢！

entries.source: Well, I cannot use it anyway.
entries.target: 反正我也用不上它。

entries.source:
Ah yes! I am so glad! I will be able to go back to Angolw...err... Oh well, I guess I can tell you; you deserve it for helping me.
During the dark years of the Spellhunt, many thousands of years ago, Linaniil, the great mage of the Kar'Krul, worried that magic might disappear with her generation and be lost to mortals should they need it again.
So she set a secret plan into action and built a secret place where magic would be kept alive.
Her plan worked and the group built a town called Angolwen in the western mountains. #LIGHT_GREEN#*He marks it on your map, along with a portal to access it*#WHITE#
Not many people are accepted there but I will arrange for you to be allowed inside.
entries.target:
啊，太棒了！我终于可以回到安格利……呃……好吧，我想我可以告诉你；你帮了我，理应知道这些。
几千年前，在魔法狩猎的黑暗年代，卡·克鲁尔的大法师莱娜尼尔担心魔法会随她那一代一同消失，日后凡人再需要时便无从寻觅。
于是她秘密实施了一项计划，建造了一处隐秘之地，让魔法得以传承。
她的计划成功了，众人在西部群山中建起了一座名为安格利文的小镇。#LIGHT_GREEN#*他在你的地图上标出小镇及其入口传送门的位置。*#WHITE#
能获准进入那里的人不多，但我会安排让你进去。

entries.source: Oh! How could such a place be kept secret for so long... This is interesting indeed. Thank you for your trust!
entries.target: 哦！这样的地方怎么能保密这么久……确实很有意思。谢谢你信任我！

entries.source:
Ah yes! I am so glad! I will be able to go back to Angolwen now, and perhaps we will meet there.
Please take this ring; it has served me well.
entries.target:
啊，太棒了！我终于可以回到安格利文了，也许我们会在那里再次见面。
请收下这枚戒指，它帮了我不少忙。

entries.source: Thanks, and best luck in your studies!
entries.target: 谢谢，也祝你学业顺利！

entries.source: Select the item to recharge
entries.target: 选择要充能的物品

entries.source: Not enough money
entries.target: 金钱不足

entries.source: This costs %d gold.
entries.target: 这将花费%d金币。

entries.source: Recharge?
entries.target: 充能？

entries.source: This will cost you %d gold.
entries.target: 这将花费你%d金币。

entries.source: Welcome, @playername@, to my shop.
entries.target: 欢迎来我的商店，@playername@。

entries.source: Let me see your wares.
entries.target: 让我看看你的商品吧。

entries.source: I want to recharge some of my equipment.
entries.target: 我想给一些装备充能。

entries.source: Sorry, I have to go!
entries.target: 抱歉，我要走了！
